title: Pools of Arlithrien
wikitext:
[[File:Pools Arlithrien.jpg|thumb|The Pools of Arlithrien.]]

The '''Pools of Arlithrien''' is a collection of small pools in western [[Teldrassil]], located south of the entrance to [[Darnassus]].  While once a peaceful area, the pools are now home to hostile wildlife. There is a lone [[moonwell]] in this area, abandoned by the [[Night elf|night elves]] due to the threat of [[Gnarlpine]] [[furbolg]]s. The Pools of Arlithrien is found at {{Coords|40|65|Teldrassil}}.
